Add support for TPROXY via a new bpf helper
This helper requires the BPF program to discover the socket via a call
to bpf_sk*_lookup_*()
column2: then pass this socket to the new helper. The

column1: helper takes its own reference to the socket in addition to any existing
reference that may or may not currently be obtained for the duration of
BPF processing. For the destination socket to receive the traffic
traffic must be routed towards that socket via local route. The
simplest example route is below
column2: but in practice you may want to route

column1: traffic more narrowly (eg by CIDR):
$ ip route add local default dev lo
This patch avoids trying to introduce an extra bit into the skb->sk
that would require more invasive changes to all code interacting with
the socket to ensure that the bit is handled correctly
error-handling cases along the path from the helper in BPF through to
the orphan path in the input. Instead
column2: we opt to use the destructor

column1: variable to switch on the prefetch of the socket.
